content: Amma waɗi ɗiɗi ɗee yoɓɓi e heɓɓugo ummoraade so wonaa maɓɓe, so 800,000 ɗiɗi e keɓe Naange luggere Soviet Union waɗi yenande, teeɓude e ndeeɓɓe nanndugo Biilorus e Ukren, waɗude ɓe ɓe yahi ndiyam balɗe ɗe laawol Poland ngal rewti, ɓurti Tawiinu Rimga, looweede non-aggression Soviet-Poland, e ko fiɗɗaaji ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi waɗi laawol leydiɓe, so tawii ko ɓe waɗi e dowro walla e dowroji kala.
